{{Top|leg}}
A '''sailing droid''' was a class of [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]] designed to tutor individuals in the art of sailing and crewing ocean-going sailed vessels. The [[WBY-102 FirstMate]] was an example of a sailing [[Droid/Legends|droid]].
